verdict.rationale: The developer docs show an in-product "Ask AI" chat feature, with conversations, messages and tool calls retrievable via the API. They also mention "scheduled prompts" that generate chats automatically, which implies AI-produced insights from the user's own data. All of this is inferred from API endpoint descriptions, not from first-party documentation of the feature itself. The MCP server only gives external tools access, so it is not credited as in-product. Missing for 10: direct documentation of the Ask AI feature's capabilities, evidence of proactive suggestions (not just Q&A), and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
